# proxmox_node_certificates_info (Data Source)

Reads the certificates of a node from `GET /nodes/{node}/certificates/info`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_certificates_info" "certs" {
  node = "pve-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `filename` (String)
- `fingerprint` (String)
- `issuer` (String)
- `notafter` (Number)
- `notbefore` (Number)
- `pem` (String)
- `public_key_bits` (Number)
- `public_key_type` (String)
- `san` (List of String)
- `subject` (String)
